newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise November rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise November rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday that it was raising the margin requirement on its November rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Tuesday.
The hike will bring the total November rubber futures contract to 157,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increases are intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on its December contract will be unchanged at 62,500 yen, while those on other rubber futures contracts will remain at 52,500 yen.
